001package bank.reporting;
002
003import bank.model.Account;
004import bank.model.Customer;
005import bank.model.Transaction;
006
007import java.math.BigDecimal;
008import java.time.LocalDateTime;
009import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
010import java.util.ArrayList;
011import java.util.Collections;
012import java.util.List;
013
014/**
015 * ============================================================================
016 *  StatementGenerator.java
017 *  Owner: John (smartdude879@gmail.com)
018 * ============================================================================
019 *
020 *  ROLE:
021 *      Prints a formatted monthly statement to the terminal for a given customer
022 *      and date range.
023 *
024 *  STRUCTURE:
025 *      - Header              : customer name, statement period
026 *      - Per-account section : account ID, type, opening balance,
027 *                              transactions, closing balance
028 *      - Footer              : totals for deposits, withdrawals, fees, interest
029 * ============================================================================
030 */
031public class StatementGenerator {
032
033    private static final int LINE_WIDTH = 65;
034    private static final String DIVIDER = "-".repeat(LINE_WIDTH);
035    private static final String DOUBLE_DIVIDER = "=".repeat(LINE_WIDTH);
036    private static final DateTimeFormatter DATE_FMT =
037            DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("MMM dd, yyyy HH:mm");
038    private static final DateTimeFormatter PERIOD_FMT =
039            DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("MMM dd, yyyy");
040    private static final DateTimeFormatter ROW_FMT =
041            DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("MMM dd HH:mm");
042
043    /**
044     * Generates and prints the statement for the customer between fromDate and
045     * toDate (both inclusive).
046     *
047     * @param customer  the customer whose statement to print
048     * @param fromDate  start of statement period (inclusive)
049     * @param toDate    end of statement period (inclusive)
050     */
051    public void generate(Customer customer, LocalDateTime fromDate, LocalDateTime toDate) {
052        printHeader(customer, fromDate, toDate);
053
054        BigDecimal totalDeposits    = BigDecimal.ZERO;
055        BigDecimal totalWithdrawals = BigDecimal.ZERO;
056        BigDecimal totalFees        = BigDecimal.ZERO;
057        BigDecimal totalInterest    = BigDecimal.ZERO;
058
059        for (Account account : customer.getAccounts()) {
060            // Pick out this account's transactions inside the date range.
061            List<Transaction> txns = new ArrayList<>();
062            for (Transaction t : customer.getTransactions()) {
063                boolean sameAccount = t.getAccountId().equals(account.getId());
064                boolean inRange = !t.getTimestamp().isBefore(fromDate)
065                        && !t.getTimestamp().isAfter(toDate);
066                if (sameAccount && inRange) {
067                    txns.add(t);
068                }
069            }
070            Collections.sort(txns, (a, b) -> a.getTimestamp().compareTo(b.getTimestamp()));
071
072            // Opening balance = current balance MINUS everything that happened
073            // in this period.
074            BigDecimal closingBalance = account.getBalance();
075            BigDecimal netEffect = BigDecimal.ZERO;
076            for (Transaction t : txns) {
077                netEffect = netEffect.add(signedAmount(t));
078            }
079            BigDecimal openingBalance = closingBalance.subtract(netEffect);
080
081            printAccountSection(account, openingBalance, closingBalance, txns);
082
083            for (Transaction t : txns) {
084                switch (t.getType()) {
085                    case DEPOSIT:
086                    case TRANSFER_IN:
087                        totalDeposits = totalDeposits.add(t.getAmount());
088                        break;
089                    case WITHDRAW:
090                    case TRANSFER_OUT:
091                        totalWithdrawals = totalWithdrawals.add(t.getAmount());
092                        break;
093                    case FEE:
094                        totalFees = totalFees.add(t.getAmount());
095                        break;
096                    case INTEREST:
097                        totalInterest = totalInterest.add(t.getAmount());
098                        break;
099                    default:
100                        break;
101                }
102            }
103        }
104
105        printFooter(totalDeposits, totalWithdrawals, totalFees, totalInterest);
106    }
107
108    // ── Print helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
109
110    private void printHeader(Customer customer, LocalDateTime from, LocalDateTime to) {
111        System.out.println();
112        System.out.println(DOUBLE_DIVIDER);
113        System.out.println(center("ACCOUNT STATEMENT", LINE_WIDTH));
114        System.out.println(DOUBLE_DIVIDER);
115        System.out.printf("  Customer   : %s (ID: %s)%n", customer.getName(), customer.getId());
116        System.out.printf("  Period     : %s  ->  %s%n",
117                from.format(PERIOD_FMT), to.format(PERIOD_FMT));
118        System.out.printf("  Generated  : %s%n", LocalDateTime.now().format(DATE_FMT));
119        System.out.println(DOUBLE_DIVIDER);
120    }
121
122    private void printAccountSection(Account account,
123                                     BigDecimal openingBalance,
124                                     BigDecimal closingBalance,
125                                     List<Transaction> txns) {
126        System.out.println();
127        System.out.println(DIVIDER);
128        System.out.printf("  Account : %-20s  Type: %s%n",
129                account.getId(), account.getType());
130        System.out.println(DIVIDER);
131        System.out.printf("  %-38s  %10s%n", "Opening Balance", fmt(openingBalance));
132        System.out.println(DIVIDER);
133
134        if (txns.isEmpty()) {
135            System.out.println("  No transactions in this period.");
136        } else {
137            System.out.printf("  %-12s  %-18s  %-12s  %10s%n",
138                    "Date", "Description", "Type", "Amount");
139            System.out.println("  " + ".".repeat(LINE_WIDTH - 2));
140            for (Transaction t : txns) {
141                System.out.printf("  %-12s  %-18s  %-12s  %10s%n",
142                        t.getTimestamp().format(ROW_FMT),
143                        truncate(t.getDescription(), 18),
144                        t.getType(),
145                        signedFmt(t));
146            }
147        }
148
149        System.out.println(DIVIDER);
150        System.out.printf("  %-38s  %10s%n", "Closing Balance", fmt(closingBalance));
151    }
152
153    private void printFooter(BigDecimal deposits,
154                              BigDecimal withdrawals,
155                              BigDecimal fees,
156                              BigDecimal interest) {
157        System.out.println();
158        System.out.println(DOUBLE_DIVIDER);
159        System.out.println(center("SUMMARY", LINE_WIDTH));
160        System.out.println(DOUBLE_DIVIDER);
161        System.out.printf("  %-38s  %10s%n", "Total Deposits",    fmt(deposits));
162        System.out.printf("  %-38s  %10s%n", "Total Withdrawals", fmt(withdrawals));
163        System.out.printf("  %-38s  %10s%n", "Total Fees",        fmt(fees));
164        System.out.printf("  %-38s  %10s%n", "Total Interest",    fmt(interest));
165        System.out.println(DOUBLE_DIVIDER);
166        System.out.println();
167    }
168
169    // ── Formatting utilities ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
170
171    /** Signed net effect of a transaction (positive = credit, negative = debit). */
172    private BigDecimal signedAmount(Transaction t) {
173        switch (t.getType()) {
174            case DEPOSIT:
175            case TRANSFER_IN:
176            case INTEREST:
177                return t.getAmount();
178            case WITHDRAW:
179            case TRANSFER_OUT:
180            case FEE:
181                return t.getAmount().negate();
182            default:
183                return BigDecimal.ZERO;
184        }
185    }
186
187    private String signedFmt(Transaction t) {
188        BigDecimal signed = signedAmount(t);
189        String prefix = signed.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) >= 0 ? "+" : "";
190        return prefix + fmt(signed);
191    }
192
193    private String fmt(BigDecimal value) {
194        return String.format("$%,.2f", value);
195    }
196
197    private String center(String text, int width) {
198        int padding = (width - text.length()) / 2;
199        return " ".repeat(Math.max(0, padding)) + text;
200    }
201
202    private String truncate(String s, int max) {
203        if (s == null) return "";
204        return s.length() <= max ? s : s.substring(0, max - 1) + "~";
205    }
206}
